meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget wedding sarees** ke liye online aapko *simple silk-look, georgette, organza, aur soft net* sarees dekhni chahiye, kyunki inme wedding feel bhi aati hai aur price bhi manageable rehta hai.[1][12][15][18]

**Best budget options:**
- **Meesho**: sabse sasti options mil rahi hain, wedding sarees **₹149 se start** hoti hain, aur kaafi pieces **₹299 se neeche** bhi listed hain.[1]
- **Myntra / Meesho**: budget-friendly saree categories jaise **silk below ₹500**, **georgette below ₹500**, **pattu below ₹1000**, aur **linen below ₹1000** mil jaati hain.[15][18]
- **Manyavar Mohey**: wedding/party sarees ka mix milta hai; prices roughly **₹1,499 se ₹17,999** tak listed hain, so mid-budget ke liye useful hai.[12]
- **Sudathi**: brand apni wedding collection ko **elegant aur stylish without overspending** ke liye position karta hai.[8]
- **Libas**: wedding sarees pe discounts aur ready-to-wear styles available hain.[4]
- **Amrut Fashion**: kuch wedding sarees **₹2,499 sale price** par listed hain.[13]

**Agar shaadi ke liye sabse value-for-money chahiye, to ye types choose karo:**
- **Silk-look saree** — shaadi wali look deti hai, cost usually lower than pure bridal silk.[15][18]
- **Banarasi-style saree** — guest/relative look ke liye strong traditional option hai.[9][14]
- **Georgette / Organza saree with embroidery** — light, stylish, aur budget mein mil jaati hai.[12][15]
- **Soft net saree** — festive look ke liye achhi, especially functions aur receptions ke liye.[15]

**Quick buying tips:**
- Agar aap *guest* ho to **₹1,000–₹3,000** range best रहती hai.
- Agar *bride side* ke liye semi-bridal look chahiye to **₹3,000–₹8,000** dekh sakte ho.
- Product photos ke saath **fabric**, **blouse piece**, **work type**, aur **return policy** zaroor check karo, kyunki budget platforms par quality vary kar sakti hai.[1][15]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **budget** ke hisaab se 3 categories bana deta hoon: **under ₹1,000, ₹1,000–₹3,000, aur ₹3,000–₹8,000**.
